speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, have you experienced any changes in your urine, such as foaming or dark color? Also, have you noticed any swelling in your hands or face?

speaker: Patient
text: 66-year-old white male. The patient reports a 10-day history of fatigue and bilateral lower leg swelling. He mentions a weight loss of 3.6 kg (8 lbs) over the past 6 months without trying. He has a history of chronic bronchitis and uses an albuterol inhaler as needed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome. Given the age, bilateral leg swelling, fatigue, and unintentional weight loss, this constellation of symptoms strongly suggests significant proteinuria and hypoalbuminemia. Has your urine appeared frothy or bubbly? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum Albumin, and Creatinine.
